items.criterion: Navigate Xbox.com to the 'Best sellers' section
items.description: Use Xbox.com (starting from https://www.xbox.com/en-US/ is acceptable) and make a reasonable attempt to locate the “Best sellers” section (or equivalent clearly best-selling list) on Xbox.com. Full credit if the agent reaches the Best sellers area OR if Xbox.com prevents access/visibility due to uncontrollable blockers (e.g., site not loading, CAPTCHA, region/age gating, persistent cookie/consent overlay, A/B layout where Best sellers is not present) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and what was attempted. Partial credit if the agent finds a comparable best-selling list that is not clearly labeled “Best sellers” when “Best sellers” is not readily discoverable.

items.criterion: Open a product page for a game from 'Best sellers'
items.description: Select any one game shown in the “Best sellers” list (or closest equivalent best-selling list found) and open its product page on Xbox.com. Full credit if the opened page is clearly the product page for a game that was presented in the Best sellers list. If opening the product page is blocked by uncontrollable factors (e.g., age/region gating, repeated redirects, site errors), full credit if the agent demonstrates a reasonable attempt and clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if a product page is opened on Xbox.com but traceability to Best sellers is unclear due to page changes or missing context.

items.criterion: Report publisher, developer, and release date from the product page
items.description: From the opened game product page, record and report the game’s publisher, developer, and release date as displayed on Xbox.com (including within expandable sections like “Details”/“More information” if present). Full credit if all three fields are correctly captured. If one or more of these fields are not shown/are unavailable on the product page due to Xbox.com content differences, locale/region, or gating, full credit if the agent clearly states which fields are missing/unavailable and does not fabricate. Partial credit if only 2 of 3 are reported when the third is visible, or if there are minor transcription errors.

items.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in; no purchase or download; stop after recording details)
items.description: Comply with constraints by not signing in and not buying or downloading anything, and stop after opening the product page and recording publisher/developer/release date (or reporting unavailability of those fields). Full credit if the agent avoids sign-in and avoids completing any purchase/download flows and stops promptly after collecting required info. Partial credit if the agent navigates near purchase/download CTAs or unavoidable interstitials appear but no transaction/download/sign-in is initiated or completed. No credit if the agent signs in or initiates/completes a purchase or download.
